teaser.en: A fisherman's shrub: its sticks are used to catch koe, a small sea creature.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha wavuvi: vijiti vyake hutumika kuvua koe, kiumbe mdogo wa baharini.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha avuvi: vigongovye nkuhumirwa kuvuwa *koe*, nyama mdide wa bahari.

summary.en: Mvua koe is Pluchea sordida, a coastal shrub of the daisy family. Its name means 'fisher of koe', because its sticks are used to fish for koe, a crustacean of the sea.
summary.sw: Mvua koe ni Pluchea sordida, kichaka cha pwani cha familia ya alizeti. Jina lake lina maana ya 'mvuvi wa koe', kwa sababu vijiti vyake hutumika kuvua koe, mnyama wa jamii ya kaa wa baharini.
summary.dg: *Mvua koe* ni *Pluchea sordida*, chitsaka cha pwani cha jamii ya *daisy*. Dzinare rina mana ya 'mvuvi wa koe', kpwa sababu vigongovye nkuhumirwa kuvuwa *koe*, nyama wa bahari wa jamii ya tande.

about.en: Mvua koe is a soft, much-branched shrub with grey-green, softly hairy, often slightly sticky and aromatic leaves. Its small purplish or whitish flower heads grow in clusters at the branch ends, as in other Pluchea species.
about.sw: Mvua koe ni kichaka laini chenye matawi mengi, na majani ya rangi ya kijivu-kijani yenye manyoya laini, mara nyingi yanayonata kidogo na yenye harufu. Vichwa vyake vidogo vya maua, vya rangi ya zambarau au nyeupe-nyeupe, huota kwa mafungu kwenye ncha za matawi, kama ilivyo kwa spishi nyingine za Pluchea.
about.dg: *Mvua koe* ni chitsaka laini chenye panda nyinji, na makodza ga rangi ya ivu na chijani, genye nyere laini; mara nyinji ganagonyata chidide na gana arufu. Vitswa vidide vya maruwa, vya zambarau-zambarau au vyereru-vyereru, vinamera mafungu kpwenye ntsa za panda, dza kpwa aina zanjina za *Pluchea*.

where.en: It grows near the coast, in bushland and on sandy ground close to the shore.
where.sw: Huota karibu na pwani, vichakani na kwenye ardhi ya mchanga karibu na ufuo.
where.dg: Unamera phephi na bahari, weruni na kpwenye tsi ya mtsanga phephi na kanda ya bahari.

uses.en: Pakia records that its sticks are used for fishing koe, a kind of crustacean in the sea.
uses.sw: Pakia anaripoti kwamba vijiti vyake hutumika kuvua koe, aina ya mnyama wa jamii ya kaa anayeishi baharini.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala vigongovye nkuhumirwa kuvuwa *koe*, aina ya nyama wa bahari wa jamii ya tande.

culture.en: Pakia pairs it with Mvua pweza, 'fisher of octopus' (Ochna thomasiana), as plants named for their part in Digo fishing.
culture.sw: Pakia anauweka pamoja na Mvua pweza, 'mvuvi wa pweza' (Ochna thomasiana), kama mimea iliyopewa majina kutokana na nafasi yake katika uvuvi wa Wadigo.
culture.dg: Pakia anauunga na *Mvua pweza*, 'mvuvi wa pweza' (*Ochna thomasiana*), dza mimea iriyoihwa madzina kpwa sababu nkuhumirwa ni Adigo kuvuwa.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mvua koe, 'fisher of koe'. No shared names are recorded. Its scientific name is Pluchea sordida.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti jina la Kidigo Mvua koe, 'mvuvi wa koe'. Hakuna majina ya pamoja na lugha nyingine yaliyoripotiwa. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Pluchea sordida.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *Mvua koe*, 'mvuvi wa koe'. Takuna madzina ga luga zanjina garigoandikpwa. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Pluchea sordida*.

reason.sw: Umepewa jina kutokana na uvuvi wa pweza

reason.dg: Mmea wanjina wa kanda ya bahari
